set.body: Deliver an idiomatic Scala atlas API centered on the existing exact AtlasRealization/locus4s assignment and field model. Source review: docs/plans/atlas-review-2026-09-30.md, reference neuroatlas d65ff97; visualization excluded. Tag: atlas-typed-20260930. Prior atlas-domain tickets are closed; this follow-up repairs newly reproduced identity/API defects before completing parcel workflows and loader coverage. Acceptance: each child has bounded evidence, shared computation passes JVM and JS, R semantics needing parity have independent fixtures, acquisition is explicit and pinned, no duplicate generic algebra. Spin inference and probabilistic membership are separate future design work. The first execution slice is canonical parcel identity; the remaining roadmap stays open until implemented and verified.
set.title: Epic: typed atlas workflows and neuroatlas capability gaps
